llmJudgeRequirements.description: Store hook is created with `create` from `zustand`
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Store is created via `create<FeedStore>(...)` imported from 'zustand' and assigned to `useFeedStore`.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Async fetch action calls `set` to write loading state before awaiting network work
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: `fetchFeed` calls `set({ status: 'loading', error: null, ... })` synchronously before the first `await fetch(...)` call.
evidence: set({ status: 'loading', error: null, lastRequest: { limit, skip } })

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Async fetch action writes success data and error state through `set` in separate branches
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: try branch calls `set({ status: 'success', items: mappedItems, error: null })` and catch branch calls `set({ status: 'error', error: message, items: [] })` as separate code paths.
evidence: set({ status: 'success', items: mappedItems, error: null })

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Error UI retry trigger calls the same async store action used by initial fetch
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: `retry` reads `lastRequest` from state and delegates directly to `get().fetchFeed(limit, skip)`, which is the same async store action used by the initial fetch button.
evidence: retry: async () => { const { limit, skip } = get().lastRequest; await get().fetchFeed(limit, skip) }

llmJudgeRequirements.description: UI output branches by lifecycle status values for idle loading success and error
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: `statusContent` is a record keyed by all four `FeedStatus` values ('idle', 'loading', 'success', 'error'), each mapping to distinct React nodes, and `{statusContent[status]}` renders the active branch.
evidence: const statusContent = { idle: ..., loading: ..., success: ..., error: ... } satisfies Record<FeedStatus, React.ReactNode>
